title: Plant Watering Scheduler
description: Never forget to water again: per-plant watering intervals, next-due dates computed from the last watering, and one-tap 'watered' check-off.
howto: Add each plant with its watering interval in days and when you last watered it.
The list shows next-due dates, sorted with the thirstiest first and overdue in red.
Tap 'Watered' when you water — the due date recalculates instantly.
Everything is saved in your browser automatically.

faqs.q: Where is my plant list stored?
faqs.a: In your browser's localStorage, namespaced to this tool. It stays on this device and browser.

faqs.q: How is the next due date computed?
faqs.a: Last-watered date + interval days. Tapping 'Watered' sets last-watered to today and moves the due date forward.
Any plant whose due date is before today is highlighted red; due today is amber; the rest are green.
